value.rationale: The rank-one funNyström method is literature-motivated and relevant to matrix-function approximation. A universal per-realization Frobenius descent theorem clarifies when extra power iterations are safe for nonlinear matrix functions; the sharp 2x2 Gaussian expected-error formula reveals a qualitative distinction (half the exponent) between almost-sure and expected convergence due to rare sketches. A nondecreasing counterexample gives a substantive functional boundary. No unsupported block-rank, spectral-norm, or finite-precision generalization is claimed.
